body.x: Edyn(www.edyn.com), a smart garden system brand that helps monitoring and tracking environmental conditions, unveiled Edyn Garden Sensor and Water Valve at Digital Experience, the press party before the official opening of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.The Edyn Garden Sensor is a solar-powered and wi-fi enabled plant growing device. It is made to be water and fertilizer resistant for durability. With Edyn iOS app, users can monitor the soil nutrition, moisture, light and temperature.

The Edyn Water Valve fits standard Garden Hose Thread (GHT 1 1/16th" Fittings). It is compatible with most drip irrigation, soaker hose or garden hose-fed sprinklers. Compatible with most washing machine fittings, it automatically waters plants only when they need it, based on data from the Edyn Garden Sensor. The Edyn iOS app allows manual control of the Water Valve remotely.
